newsitem.title: USA: Mesaba Airlines November load factor up.
newsitem.headline: Mesaba Airlines November load factor up.

text.p: Mesaba Airlines, a unit of Mesaba Holdings Inc, operating as Northwest Airlink, said its November passenger load factor rose 1.2 points to 48.0 percent from 46.8 percent a year ago.
Available seat miles increased 19.5 percent to 72.5 million from 60.7 million, and revenue passenger miles advanced 22.5 percent to 34.8 million from 28.4 million.

Year to date, the carrier said its load factor rose 6.6 points to 51.9 percent. Available seat miles gained 14.6 percent to 748.1 million from 652.8 million, and revenue passenger miles were up 31.2 percent at 388.2 million.
